name: Hollow Knight Multiplayer (HKMP)
description: Dedicated server for Hollow Knight Multiplayer (HKMP) by Extremelyd1. Dual-stack IPv4 and IPv6 compatible.
author: arshio.arshio.arshio@gmail.com

installation.content:
#!/bin/bash

apt update
apt install -y curl jq unzip ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" = "1" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" = "true" ]; then
    echo "Skipping download as USER_UPLOAD is enabled."
    exit 0
fi

if [ -z "${HKMP_VERSION}" ] || [ "${HKMP_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    echo "Fetching latest HKMP release..."
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/Extremelyd1/HKMP/releases/latest | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name=="HKMPServer.zip") | .browser_download_url')
else
    echo "Fetching HKMP release ${HKMP_VERSION}..."
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/Extremelyd1/HKMP/releases/download/${HKMP_VERSION}/HKMPServer.zip"
fi

echo "Downloading HKMPServer from: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
curl -sSL -o HKMPServer.zip "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

echo "Extracting HKMPServer.zip..."
unzip -o HKMPServer.zip
rm -f HKMPServer.zip

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "HKMP Installation completed successfully!"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: The UDP listening port for the Hollow Knight Multiplayer server.

variables.name: HKMP Version
variables.description: Release tag for HKMP from GitHub (e.g. latest or v2.4.3).

variables.name: User Upload
variables.description: Skip downloading files if you are uploading your own custom server files.
